# v1.4.0 Release Notes — Persistent Mobile Auth, Fast Remote Sync & Security Wave 2

![bot-team v1.4.0 Milestone Release Cover — Persistent Mobile Auth, Fast Remote Sync & Security Wave 2](./artifact/bot-team-v140-release-cover.png)

**`bot-team v1.4.0`** hardens long-lived mobile continuity, remote media responsiveness, and transport/backend security across Desktop Electron, Cloud Web, iPadOS, iOS Home-Screen PWAs, Tier-2 `CoreServer`, and the Railway `cloud-gateway` (`2bdeca4..9705cdf` in `bot-team` and `841d89f..8da2113` in `bot-team-services` — **15 commits across 15 tracked issues**). Mobile Web and PWA sessions now stay durably authenticated across multi-day standby and iOS WebKit cookie evictions via **90-day sliding non-rotating refresh sessions** and a **dual `localStorage` + `IndexedDB` self-healing auth vault** (`#F-555`). Remote workspace wakeups and image-heavy timelines feel instantaneous with **compact mobile SSE snapshots**, **Cache-API-first zero-double-fetch media loading**, **prewarmed `w=480`/`w=800` thumbnails**, and a **`96 MB` singleflight Railway edge cache** (`#F-556`). Underneath, **ephemeral `X25519 + HKDF-SHA256 + AES-256-GCM` LAN P2P E2EE**, **native WebSocket binary `http.res.chunk` frames**, and **Local & Cloud Security Wave 2 (`LB-07`–`LB-11`, `CB-09`–`CB-16`)** lock down every transport boundary (`#F-557`, `#C-558-2`) — while preserving the frozen 20-file Tier-1 `AgentDaemon` closure (`ADR 0012`, `daemon-boundary` `10/10`, `daemonOutdated === false`).


## Architecture Overview (`v1.4.0`)

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Mobile["iOS PWA & Mobile Web (Dual Vault · Cache-API First · Retained RAM Cache)"]
    Desktop["Desktop & LAN Peer (X25519 + AES-256-GCM P2P E2EE · DesktopApiMux)"]
    Edge["Railway Cloud Gateway (90d Sliding Auth · 96 MB Singleflight Cache · CB-09..16)"]
    Core["Tier-2 CoreServer (Compact SSE · Prewarmed 480/800 Thumbs · LB-07..11)"]
    Services["Tier-3 AppsDaemon & ServiceHost (Scoped Auth · GraphQL Depth Limits)"]
    Daemon["Tier-1 AgentDaemon (Frozen 20-File Runtime Closure)"]

    Mobile <-->|"90d bt_cloud_rt + Header Bootstrap + Warm SSE"| Edge
    Mobile <-->|"Ephemeral X25519 + HKDF-SHA256 + AES-256-GCM"| Desktop
    Edge <-->|"Native Binary WS http.res.chunk Frames"| Core
    Desktop <-->|"Local IPC & Scoped ACLs"| Core
    Core <-->|"Authenticated Proxy & Limits"| Services
    Core -->|"Resolved Prompts & Lifecycle"| Daemon
```


## 1. Persistent Mobile Web & PWA Authentication (`#F-555` · `BOT-459`–`BOT-461`)

iOS Safari ITP, WebKit background tab purges, and multi-cookie path collisions previously caused Mobile Web and Home-Screen PWA users to lose sessions unexpectedly after extended standby. `v1.4.0` redesigns session durability end to end:

- **90-Day Sliding Non-Rotating Refresh Sessions & RFC 6265 Precedence (`BOT-459`, `bot-team-services` `d9ffdea`)**: unifies `bt_cloud_rt` onto `Path=/api` with a **90-day sliding TTL** and **24-hour JWT access tokens**, resolves RFC 6265 duplicate-cookie ordering deterministically when legacy cookies coexist, and supports an explicit `X-Bot-Team-Refresh-Token` bootstrap header fallback when mobile browsers strip or evict cookies.
- **Dual-Layer `localStorage` + `IndexedDB` Self-Healing Auth Vault (`BOT-460`, `bot-team` `57f950e`)**: mirrors Cloud and LAN Mobile Web credentials across both `localStorage` and `IndexedDB`, automatically healing missing storage entries on cold boot and recovering sessions transparently even after a full browser cookie wipe (`cli/test/mobile-persistent-auth.mjs`).
- **Live Cloud Gateway Sync & Cookie-Wipe Verification (`BOT-461`, `bot-team-services` `38bc5f8`)**: deployed live to Railway `cloud-gateway` and verified end-to-end across simulated iOS cookie wipes without dropping back to the login gate.

![Mobile Web session recovered seamlessly after full cookie wipe via the dual localStorage and IndexedDB vault](./artifact/mobile-persistent-auth-cookie-wipe-verified.png)


## 2. Fast Remote Sync & Zero-Double-Fetch Edge Media (`#F-556` · `BOT-462`–`BOT-465`)

Waking a phone onto an active workspace with hundreds of screenshots, journals, and feed cards now renders without redundant RPC bursts or double media downloads:

- **Compact Mobile SSE Snapshots & Wake RPC Deduplication (`BOT-462`, `BOT-463`, `ef35c7f`, `3909343`)**: trims mobile SSE initial/reconnect payloads, coalesces WebSocket media chunks, and deduplicates concurrent foreground/visibility/reconnect RPC bursts into a single in-flight request per endpoint.
- **Cache-API-First `useCachedMedia` & Retained iOS RAM Cache (`BOT-463`, `3909343`)**: checks persistent Cache Storage before issuing network fetches to eliminate double-fetching, retains decoded mobile RAM media entries across iOS `pagehide` / tab switches, and requests prewarmed **`w=480` and `w=800` (`q=78`)** thumbnails keyed with `mtimeMs` cache-busting.
- **Railway `96 MB` Singleflight Edge Media Cache & `5m` Warm Snapshots (`BOT-464`, `BOT-465`, `bot-team-services` `456977c`, `7ae49e7`)**: upgrades the Cloud Gateway edge cache to **`96 MB`** total capacity (**`3 MB`** max item, **`6h`** immutable / **`30m`** unversioned TTL) with singleflight request coalescing and **`5m`** warm workspace snapshots (`test/relay-media-perf.mjs`).

![Fast remote workspace sync and prewarmed edge-cached image rendering on Mobile Web](./artifact/mobile-sync-images-fast.png)


## 3. Transport Encryption, Native Binary WS & Backend Security Wave 2 (`#F-557`, `#C-558-2` · `BOT-466`–`BOT-470`)

`v1.4.0` completes Section 1 of the Near-Term Hardening Plan across direct LAN P2P channels, Cloud WebSocket relays, local host services, and the Railway Cloud Gateway:

- **Ephemeral `X25519 + HKDF-SHA256 + AES-256-GCM` LAN P2P E2EE (`BOT-466`, `c937353`)**: wraps direct LAN P2P data channels in forward-secret ephemeral `X25519` key agreement, `HKDF-SHA256` key derivation, and authenticated `AES-256-GCM` frame encryption with strict replay/nonce protection (`cli/test/lan-p2p-e2ee.mjs`), alongside **`LB-07`** local file/media ACL hardening.
- **Native WebSocket Binary `http.res.chunk` Streaming (`BOT-469`, `bot-team` `9705cdf`, `bot-team-services` `8da2113`)**: upgrades proxied HTTP/media response chunks between `CloudConnector` and `RelayHub` from base64-encoded JSON envelopes to native WebSocket binary frames (`cli/test/ws-binary-http-chunk.mjs`, `test/relay-binary-chunks.mjs`), eliminating ~33% base64 wire expansion and JSON parse overhead on large artifacts.
- **Local Backend Security Wave 2 (`BOT-467`, `c7082ec` · `LB-07`–`LB-11`)**: enforces `ApiGateway` and `ServiceHost` authentication boundaries (`LB-08`), strict `spaceKey` and path traversal sanitization (`LB-09`, `LB-10`), and workspace-scoped GraphQL execution with query depth and complexity caps (`LB-11`; `cli/test/security-local-wave2.mjs`).
- **Cloud Gateway Security Wave 2 (`BOT-468`, `BOT-470`, `bot-team-services` `b654d9d` · `CB-09`–`CB-16`)**: adds refresh-token `family_id` tracking and full-family compromise/logout revocation, restricts unauthenticated `GET /api/cloud/bootstrap` to `iceServers: []` (`CB-11` — zero TURN credential exposure), enforces `Strict-Transport-Security`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, and `Content-Security-Policy` response headers (`CB-16`), and guards production boot on `JWT_SECRET >= 32` bytes (`CB-15`; `test/security-cloud-wave2.mjs`).


## 4. Mobile & Feeds Minimal Mode Polish (`#F-544`–`#F-547`, `#F-382` · `BOT-452`, `BOT-453`, `BOT-458`)

Daily triage in Feeds Minimal Mode and Mobile Feeds receives targeted layout and typography polish:

- **Complete 2-Line Fallback Titles, Borderless Expand & Descender Safety (`BOT-452`, `721c3cb`, `#F-544`, `#F-545`, `#F-547`)**: removes premature first-period truncation in `deriveExtendedFallbackTitle` so multi-sentence posts fill two clean lines (`#F-547`), drops the redundant top divider inside expanded Minimal Mode cards (`#F-544`), and widens status-pill line height to `leading-[1.35]` so `g`/`y`/`p` descenders never clip (`#F-545`).
- **Pinned Non-Bouncing Mobile Feeds Channel Bar (`BOT-453`, `bc8d117`, `#F-546`)**: moves the Mobile Feeds channel tab bar flush beneath the top header outside the elastic scroll container so downward overscroll and pull-to-refresh gestures never pull or bounce the channel strip.
- **Bottom Comment `Reply` Action Row (`BOT-458`, `73a4d08`, `#F-382`)**: relocates the inline comment `Reply` trigger from the right header edge to a quiet bottom action row beneath each `FeedCommentRow` across Desktop and Mobile.

![Minimal Mode 2-line fallback titles, borderless expanded body, and clean descender rendering on Desktop](./artifact/feeds-minimal-desktop.png)

![Pinned Mobile Feeds channel tab bar staying flush beneath the header during scroll and pull-to-refresh](./artifact/mobile-feeds-channel-bar-pinned.png)

## Verification & Architectural Guardrails

- **Frozen Tier-1 `AgentDaemon` Boundary (`ADR 0012`)**: all 15 engineering slices live strictly in Tier-2 (`CoreServer`), Tier-3 (`AppsDaemon` / `ServiceHost`), renderer/mobile clients, and `bot-team-services` — leaving the 20-file `DAEMON_DIST_FILES` closure 100% byte-identical (`daemon-boundary.mjs` `10/10`, `daemonOutdated === false`).
- **End-to-End Security & Performance Suites**: verified across `lan-p2p-e2ee.mjs`, `security-local-wave2.mjs`, `ws-binary-http-chunk.mjs`, `core-hot-reload.mjs`, `security-cloud-wave1.mjs`, `security-cloud-wave2.mjs`, `relay-binary-chunks.mjs`, `relay-media-perf.mjs`, `cloud-e2e.mjs`, and `pnpm lint:comments` (`0` violations).
- **Editorial Cover & Visual Standards (`#F-391` · `#C-374-1` · `#F-199`)**: authored for `BOT-471` (`#F-562`) with flat Apple Newsroom `#F5F5F7` cover art (`./artifact/bot-team-v140-release-cover.png` — pure matte `#F5F5F7` canvas, flat `#FFFFFF` cards with `1px` `#D2D2D7` hairlines, zero neon, zero gradients, zero colored left-border stripes).
